audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice with a neutral, slightly echoey tone calls out 'Number 2772, your songs have arrived.' The main character responds in a casual, slightly high-pitched voice, 'Finally, I've waited so long.' There is no background music yet, just subtle room tone. (2) High-tempo rock music with electric guitars and a strong drum beat suddenly starts. The main character sings loudly and with high arousal, matching the energetic '自由' track. Occasional percussive hits from the beat are prominent. (3) The audio shifts to a fast-paced electronic dance track with a heavy synth bassline. The man sings '眉飛色舞,' his voice exhibiting high pitch variability and energetic projection, with a synthesized texture in the music. (4) The music transitions into a power ballad/rock song, '海闊天空,' characterized by piano and sweeping strings. The man sings emotionally in Cantonese, but his voice breaks into a sharp, dry cough twice, followed by more singing. (5) The music cuts out abruptly. An off-screen male voice states '70 million' in a flat, authoritative tone. The main character reacts with a loud, surprised exclamation, followed by a comedic comment in a lower, more somber tone with no BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Song Montage -> Performance -> Twist -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic skit portraying a man who appears to be in prison (given the context of 'Number 2772' and the song list title). He enthusiastically performs a series of classic songs about freedom using a flip-flop as a microphone. The humor stems from his exaggerated performance and the final twist where the 'private room fee' (or bail) is an astronomical 70 million, leading him to decide that staying in prison is more cost-effective than being free.
